notes.title: We are the Plague - Patch #1 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34087218/1cf537c56bf3a83530037f8e35ce3666ee9a350d.jpg[/img]

A new patch for We are the Plague on #Steam is now live! We've listened to your feedback and the first batch of fixes and improvements is waiting for you - make sure your game is up to date!

[b]PATCH NOTE[/b]
- No more camping guys! Now the chance for a counter-attack when defending is lowered to 30% (previously 100%)
- Any collectors here? We added achievements for you!
- Check out the new snazzy summary screen with convenient improvements.
- Added some minor bug fixes

notes.title: We are the Plague - News!
notes.content:

notes.title: We are here
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11464454/ba76094f8126e3f92d41f6aed0572db3bfe31cc8.jpg[/img]

Join the mysterious Plague and seek your revenge. Customize your character, traverse the devastated land with a team or alone, and fight against humanity!

Demo for 'We are the Plague' is now available on Steam!
